posts.title: A Calculator (10): It Works!
posts.description: The final post tallies everything: a working scientific calculator in 1,593 logic cells: 35% of a small, cheap FPGA with honest reflections on what the project taught and what it didn't quite nail. posts.title: A Calculator (9): Chasing the Last Digit
posts.description: The 2021 implementation worked, but "most results correct to around 12 digits" is not the same as what a 16-digit BCD machine should deliver. This post covers the 2025 rewrite: a ground-up redo of the arithmetic engine with proper guard digit and sticky bit tracking, banker's rounding, a full trig suite, ten STO/RCL memory registers, and a hardware LFSR random number generator validated throughout
